label_justification: Loop evidence: calls 10 and 30 print the tail text of generations cut at 32,768 tokens and show verbatim repetition, and call 17 counts repeated words in a cut-off generation versus a finished one. Locus: call 16 labels generations as cut-off versus finished and computes a layer-23 hidden-state direction (dims 0 and 37) plus MLP neurons separating them. Call 98 repeats this across layers 11-23 with effect sizes, and calls 99-102 trace layer-19 down_proj weights into dims 37 and 0. Edits to layer-23 down_proj, layer-23 o_proj, and layer-19 down_proj (final: 60 entries, suppress dim 37 / boost dim 0) were tried. The final layer-19 edit gave only small, noisy gains on practice GSM8K and MATH, still left 80-90% of generations cut off, and scored 0.064 on MATH-500, below the 0.29 threshold.

label_second.justification: Call 9 printed text from a generation explicitly marked as 32,768 tokens and cut_at_max_tokens; call 10 additionally displayed its repetitive ending. Call 16 computed a layer-23 hidden-state direction separating cut-off generations from finished generations, using the failure-based groups established in call 15, satisfying the locus requirement. Multiple edits were validated, but looping persisted: calls 250 and 257 reported cut-off rates above 81%, and the submitted MATH-500 score was 0.064, below 0.29. No call shows budget exhaustion or an editor claim that its tools were unavailable or nonfunctional.
